title: Setup list header at 1024 px: the description keeps its line and three header actions fold to a primary plus ⋯
body:
## Source

Walked on objectui main `efa9cb4fa` at 1024 px, Setup › Users (`/apps/setup/sys_user`): the header draws the icon tile, "Users", the Identity chip, then the description cut to "User accounts f…", then Import · Invite User · Create User · ⋯. The three labelled actions take the description's width. Audit Logs with one action keeps its full description.

## Target

1. At a header width where the actions and the description do not both fit, the actions fold first: the primary action stays labelled, the others go into the ⋯ menu above Share / Delete; the description keeps one full line (ellipsis only after the actions are folded).
2. At 1280 px and wider nothing changes.
3. The same rule on the console page header everywhere it is mounted (object lists, dashboards, Setup pages).

## File surface

`packages/app-shell/src/layout/PageHeader.tsx` (the actions cluster and its fold), tests beside.

## Acceptance

1. Tests: three actions at a 600 px header render one labelled + ⋯; the description text is complete.
2. Screenshots of Setup › Users at 1024 and 1280 px.
3. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test` green.

## Constraints

- objectui#12606 (PR #12662, in flight) edits the same header for its Setup posture; this card rebases on it and lands second.

## Evidence

Screenshots on the temporary branch `claude/console-home-login-design-20261016` of objectstack-ai/objectui (commit `0f4e3f4ee`, never merged): [r4-users-list-header.jpg](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/0f4e3f4ee/docs/design/review-r4-2026-10-16/r4-users-list-header.jpg?raw=true).

<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` from the 2026-10-16 fourth review: objectui main `efa9cb4fa`, HotCRM `4f82b815` on platform 18.0.0-next.2, the vite console on :5180 against `objectstack dev` on :4001, the maintainer's browser pane at 1024 × 768 (dark, en). The maintainer asked for every finding to be filed on the repository it belongs to, verbatim: 「全部立卡，平台问题到 objectui，审计日志核查到 objectstack，HotCRM 转化流程到 hotcrm。」</sub>
